_note: uv sync --extra aigamestore: the vendored aigamestore-gym env (vendor/aigamestore), which needs a Chromium browser (system Chrome by default). Lock-stepped: fps must equal 60 / frame_skip (10 with the default frame_skip 6).
_levels_note: No levels (an endless runner): each episode is one run, and ends when it is lost.
_keys_note: MultiKeySpec over the game's keys: curriculum 'keys' map a physical key (the JSON key -- a scanner button, say) to the key the GAME listens for (the value, e.g. 'SPACE'); held keys combine, and the logged action is the env's 0/1 vector over its keys. Hold SPACE or UP to thrust / fly; avoid zappers and missiles. The on-canvas hints are relabelled to the pressed key by the env; keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: Auto-scroll runner. Hold thrust to fly,
dodge zappers and missiles, grab coins.
